'''Dreja Darmic''' was a [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] who worked in the commercial [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Around two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Darmic was arrested on charges of tax evasion. His daughter, [[Maranne Darmic|Maranne]], believed otherwise, knowing of his sympathy towards the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]].<ref name="ST" />
